title: Instructure product privacy applies when schools use Canvas products
summary: Instructure's Product Privacy policy describes processing for academic institutions using its products, states it does not sell or rent personal information to third parties, and discusses cookies/similar tech and professional information categories. CSUSB's Canvas deployment therefore sits under both campus notices and Instructure's product privacy regime.
student_action: Read Instructure product privacy alongside campus FERPA pages.
school_action: Surface Instructure privacy + subprocessors links from the Canvas help menu.
